courses.name: Advanced Paediatric Life Support (APLS)
courses.audience: Doctors, nurses and paramedics with a minimum of two years clinical experience; junior clinicians are pointed to the one-day PLS course.

audienceEvidence.quote: The APLS course is designed for doctors, nurses and paramedics with a minimum of two years’ clinical experience.

courses.format: Mandatory pre-course online learning, then three face-to-face days (scenarios, skill stations, workshops) with practical and written assessment.

formatEvidence.quote: Three days face-to-face, 10 hours+ pre-course preparation

courses.validityQuote: candidates are issued with a certificate valid for five years.
courses.recertification: APLS 2 Day Refresher (variant "refresher"): for people who completed a full APLS course within the last 5 years and are clinically current with paediatric patients; accreditation again lasts 5 years.

recertificationEvidence.quote: To be eligible to attend a 2 Day Refresher, we request that you have (a) successfully completed a full APLS course within the last 5 years ... Accreditation lasts for 5 years, same as the 3 day course.

courses.feeNote: Each 2027 event in the Arlo feed advertises $3,300 and a discounted offer of $2,120 (refresher $2,800 / $2,120); the course text still says $1,920. Check before showing a nurse price.
courses.cpdNote: check provider (Arlo template lists Credits "PD points: 3" with no college or unit named)
courses.notInScopeYet: PLS (one-day Paediatric Life Support) is also in the APLS feed (template 37) and was not added.

courses.name: Advanced Life Support Level 1 (ALS1)

providers.name: Australian Resuscitation Council (ARC); delivered by ARC-accredited course centres
The Prince Charles Hospital, Metro North (course centre)

courses.audience: Healthcare staff with limited or infrequent exposure to crisis events who need ALS training; CPR competence is a prerequisite.

audienceEvidence.quote: It is ideal for those in healthcare with limited or infrequent exposure to crisis events needing advanced life support training.

courses.format: Course manual sent at least two weeks before, then a one-day face-to-face course.

formatEvidence.quote: This is a one-day course ... Candidates are sent a manual at least two weeks prior to the course to commence preparation for the face-to-face component.

courses.validityQuote: ALS1 and ALS2 Provider certificates are recognised by the Australian Resuscitation Council for four years . (Revalidation periods may vary based on the requirements of credentialling bodies or employers.)

recertificationEvidence.quote: To recertify ALS1 you will need to undertake another ALS1 course.

courses.feeNote: Fees are set by each course centre.

feeEvidence.quote: Course fees are set by the course centres and can vary across locations

feeExamples.provider: The Prince Charles Hospital (Metro North), Brisbane
feeExamples.quote: ALS Level 1 ... All other participants: $750 (GST Incl) ... ALS Level 2 ... All other participants: $1,500 (GST Incl)

courses.cpdNote: RACP 9 hours (Category 1); pre-approved by RACGP; ANZCA and CICM recognition. See cpdByCollege.

courses.name: Advanced Life Support Level 2 (ALS2)

providers.name: Australian Resuscitation Council (ARC); delivered by ARC-accredited course centres
ACRRM: one-day ALS2 for rural doctors (variant "acrrm-one-day")

courses.audience: Doctors, critical-care nurses (ED, CCU, ICU, HDU, acute admissions), resuscitation/MET team members and paramedics; CPR competence is a prerequisite.

audienceEvidence.quote: Appropriate participants include doctors, and nurses working in critical care areas (e.g. ED, CCU, ICU, HDU, acute admissions units) or in the resuscitation /medical emergency team, and paramedics.

courses.format: ALS2 manual sent one month before plus a pre-course MCQ paper, then two face-to-face days. A one-day ALS2 recertification course exists for current ALS2 holders.

formatEvidence.quote: This is a two-day course ... candidates are sent the ALS2 manual one month prior to the course. Candidates are required to complete a pre-course multiple choice question paper

courses.typicalLength: 2 days (recertification: 1 day; ACRRM version: online modules + 1 day)
courses.validityQuote: ALS1 and ALS2 Provider certificates are recognised by the Australian Resuscitation Council for four years . (Revalidation periods may vary based on the requirements of credentialling bodies or employers.)
courses.recertification: Full two-day ALS2, or the one-day ALS2 recertification course (requires a current ARC ALS2 certificate).

recertificationEvidence.quote: To recertify ALS2, you may either undertake a full two-day ALS2 course or the ALS2 one-day recertification course (you must hold a current Australian Resuscitation Council ALS2 certificate to enrol in this)

feeExamples.provider: The Prince Charles Hospital (Metro North), Brisbane
feeExamples.quote: ALS Level 1 ... All other participants: $750 (GST Incl) ... ALS Level 2 ... All other participants: $1,500 (GST Incl)

courses.cpdNote: RACP 18 hours (Category 1); RACGP pre-approved; ANZCA and CICM recognition (see cpdByCollege). ACRRM lists 15 CPD hours for its own ALS2 sessions (on each session row).

courses.name: NZRC CORE Advanced

providers.name: New Zealand Resuscitation Council (course owner): delivered by registered providers, e.g. Triple One Care, Emcare Services
providers.blocked: nzrc.org.nz redirects to www.resus.org.nz, which the session proxy refuses

courses.audience: Health professionals who may be expected to manage a resuscitation event (experienced nurses, anaesthetic technicians, GPs, dentists providing sedation, paramedics, registrars).

audienceEvidence.quote: CORE Advanced is for Dental and Health Professionals that may be expected to manage a resuscitation event.

courses.format: Full-day (8 hour) practical session ending with a written assessment; reading the reference book is recommended.

formatEvidence.quote: The practical session is a full day (8hrs) finishing with a written assessment.

otherEvidence.quote: NZ Resuscitation Council CORE Advanced will meet all requirements for medical personnel and is required for GP fellowship.

courses.name: NZRC CORE Immediate

providers.name: New Zealand Resuscitation Council (course owner): delivered by registered providers, e.g. Triple One Care, Resus Nelson

courses.audience: Per the Triple One Care listing: dentists (RA sedation only), dental therapists, hygienists, orthodontic auxiliaries, clinical dental technicians and other health professionals undertaking restricted activities.

audienceEvidence.quote: This course is for dentists (providing RA sedation only), dental therapists, dental hygienists orthodontic auxiliaries, Clinical Dental Technicians and other trained health professionals undertaking restricted activities.

courses.format: Six-hour practical course (one provider); another provider adds self-directed pre-course learning.

formatEvidence.quote: NZRC CORE Immediate, previously known as Level 4 Resuscitation is an Immediate course that runs for 6 hours. It does not include a skill or theory assessment.
